mutants.name: consent-skips-gone
mutants.old: let mc = config.plan(p.pieces, owner: who, dropping: Self.gone(p, config, who))

mutants.name: planner-ignores-gone
mutants.old: for r in state.records where r.owner == owner.id && gone.contains(r.piece.id) { planner.remove(r) }
mutants.new: for r in state.records where r.owner == owner.id && gone.contains(r.piece.id) { _ = r }

mutants.name: wiring-skips-gone
mutants.old: let r = await mc.apply(mc.plan(p.pieces, owner: who, dropping: Self.gone(p, config, who)))
mutants.new: let r = await mc.apply(mc.plan(p.pieces, owner: who, dropping: []))
